title: @c15t/dev-tools: Kernel-first consent debugging
description: Framework-neutral developer tools for inspecting c15t v3 consent state, resolved policy, location, IAB state, kernel events, and actions.
features: Explicit ConsentKernel binding with no global store discovery
Isolated state and event history for multiple providers
Framework-neutral DOM panel for consent, location, policy, IAB, events, and actions
Typed kernel event capture without callback instrumentation
manualInstallation: Framework adapters include this engine, so React, Next.js, Vue, and Svelte applications do not need to install it separately. Install it directly only for the imperative API:
usage: Call `destroy()` when the kernel owner unmounts
Use the framework adapter when the kernel is held in framework context
